about.build: Build {h} — reproducible; the hash is published with every release.
about.crash.hint: Off by default, and only to ElectroSwap. A crash sends the message and stack, with addresses, secrets and URLs scrubbed. A swap that fails also sends the trade, the route and — so the failure can be reproduced — your address and the balances it involved. Never a signature, and never when you simply decline a sheet.
about.dev.body: This build talks to {o} instead of ElectroSwap’s servers. Prices, activity, the marketplace and the launchpad come from there.

about.flags.none: No signed flags received yet — nothing is switched off, and the built-in scam rules apply.
about.flags.ok: Kill-switches and the scam list are signed by ElectroSwap and checked every six hours ({n} scam origins).
about.privacy: No analytics. Only ElectroSwap’s API and the chain RPCs ever see an address.

moments.criterion.coil: Farms: the ring hums brighter as DYNO accrues, dates are engraved on the ring, and Collect discharges the coil into the readout while the DYNO bar rolls. Acceptance: the multiplier and the date to 2.5× are readable at a glance; nothing twitches per block except the pending-reward digits.
moments.criterion.ignition: Unlock: the Field fades in from black around the seat avatar, the filament draws left→right, the readout digits settle from blurred to sharp; 400 ms total; must feel like a device powering on, not a page loading.
moments.criterion.legends: Electric Legends dividends: claimable ETN rises as liquid light in a glass vessel between claims; Claim drains it into the readout. Acceptance: a holder understands "marketplace fees are paying me" from the plate alone; the vessel never animates when nothing has changed.
moments.criterion.qr: Receive on mobile: the QR reads as etched into glass with gyroscope parallax on the light across it (Reanimated + device motion), static on web; it must scan first time at 30 cm.
moments.criterion.rack: Collectibles: pieces sit on glass shelves with depth, contact shadows and a specular edge from the Field; opening a piece is a shared-element move into a view where the artwork is lit by a single slow light sweep; buying a piece lands it on your shelf with a Discharge. Acceptance: a first-time viewer can tell which pieces are listed and which have offers without reading text.
moments.ignition.plate: The plates arrive last, 400 ms after the first light.
moments.ignition.seat.caption: The Field comes up around the seat

moments.legends.full: The Legends screen — the vessel at full size.
moments.qr.note: The light across the engraving follows the phone on native (device motion); on the web it is static by design. Scan it from 30 cm to review the criterion.
moments.rack.note: Press a piece to take the shared-element move into it, where the artwork is lit by one slow light sweep.

sites.account.a11y: Change the account this site sees
sites.account.body: The site is told straight away, the way it would be if you switched accounts on the site itself. No other site and no other screen is affected.
sites.compat: Answer to sites that only support MetaMask
sites.compat.hint: Off. Some sites refuse anything that does not say it is MetaMask; with this on, BoltVault says so. Nothing else changes — every request still comes to you in this wallet’s own sheet — but a site will name MetaMask in its own copy, and a site that behaves differently for MetaMask will do that too.
sites.default.hint: Off. Sites that offer a wallet chooser find BoltVault either way. Turn this on and BoltVault also takes the single slot older sites reach for — which is the same slot another extension wants, so the last one to load wins and neither is reliable.
sites.none: No site is connected. When a site asks to connect, it appears here with the account and chain it sees.
sites.note.v2: Each site keeps its own account and its own chain. Changing what Home shows never changes a site, and changing a site never tells any other site.
sites.reload: A page decides which wallet it is talking to when it loads. Reload any site you already have open for either of these to reach it.
sites.title: Connected sites
sky.empty: No campaigns right now. Star one from a share link to be told when it goes live.
sky.finalizing: Waiting for the team to finalize
spending.allow: Only send to addresses I have listed
spending.allow.add.label: Add an address
spending.allow.body: This covers sends of coins, tokens and collectibles. Swapping, bridging and anything a site asks you to sign go through the usual review instead — a list of people you pay says nothing about a contract.
spending.allow.empty: The list is empty, so only your own accounts can be sent to. Add the addresses you use.
spending.allow.hint: Off. With it on, a send to anything not on the list below is refused — there is no way past it in the moment, which is the point. Your own accounts are always allowed.
spending.exact.hint: Allow Permit2 only the amount of each swap. Safer; one more transaction per swap of that token.
spending.preview.hint: Electroneum’s public nodes cannot simulate, so the preview is done by ElectroSwap: your address and the transaction’s data are sent there before you sign. Turn this off to keep them on your device — you will still be warned when a transaction would fail.
spending.recipient.none: In-wallet swaps are off on this network
spending.slippage.body: How far the price may move between your quote and the block that fills it before the swap gives up.
spending.stepups.body.v3: A recipient you have never sent to holds the key for ten seconds, with the whole address on screen to check. A large send asks you to unlock again — your face, your fingerprint or your password — before the key opens.
spending.stepups.limits: Both are always on for a transfer BoltVault can read. A contract call it cannot decode gets the full review sheet instead, because a pause on a transaction nobody can explain would be a comfort, not a check.
spending.threshold.body: Measured against how much of that token you hold, never against a price. A quarter of your ETN is a quarter of your ETN whatever the market is doing.
splash.name: BoltVault
swap.blocked: {s} is marked unsafe to trade. Its contract behaves in a way that takes money from the people who hold it — BoltVault will not swap it. Pick another token.
swap.coach.1.body: The shared allowance contract ElectroSwap uses. One signature per token, ever.
swap.coach.2.body: A signed message, not a transaction. Nothing else can move.
swap.coach.3.body: Paying with ETN needs only this one.
swap.coach.fee: The wallet fee comes out of what you receive; holding BOLT lowers it. Tap the fee line for the schedule.
swap.coach.title: Your first swap
swap.exactOut.a11y: Set the exact amount you receive
swap.fee.onTop: added to what you pay, so you receive the full amount
swap.pick.none: Nothing matches. Paste a token address to add it.
swap.pick.search: Search by name or paste an address
swap.slippage.body: How far the price may move between the quote and the block it lands in. The swap reverts past this instead of paying more.
swap.slippage.high: Above 3% a swap can be front-run for the difference.
swap.slippage.title: Slippage
swap.tax.label: Token tax
swap.title: Swap
swap.warned: Strong warning on {s}. The market flags this token as risky to hold; read its page before you trade it.
token.add.chain.title: Add a token on
token.add.label: Contract address
token.add.nocode: There is no contract at that address on this chain.
token.add.note: Anyone can deploy a token with any name. Check the address against the project’s own site before you trust it.
token.add.title: Add a token
token.bridge.note: The same asset on other chains, over the Hyperlane Nexus bridge.
token.market.none: Market data arrives from ElectroSwap once the wallet key is enabled on the API.
trezor.unavailable: A Trezor connects from the browser extension. On the phone you can watch its address and sign on your paired computer — pair it under Settings › Devices.
tx.data.label: Data
unlock.biometric.fail: That did not unlock the vault. Use your password.
unlock.help: Forgot the password? There is no reset. Restore from your recovery phrase on a fresh install instead.
unlock.passkey.fail: The passkey did not unlock the vault. Use your password.
unlock.title: Unlock BoltVault
unlock.wrong: That password does not open this vault.
update.body: This version ({v}) is older than the minimum ElectroSwap signed ({m}) — usually a security fix. Your vault stays where it is; the update just needs installing.
update.title: Update BoltVault to keep going
watch.label: Watch address
watch.only: Watch-only — import a key or pair a device.
wc.body: Paste or scan a wc: link from a site. The site then asks to connect like any other, and its signatures come through the same sheet.
wc.title: WalletConnect
wc.web: WalletConnect lives in the phone app. In the browser, BoltVault is already in every tab.
